disposition: VALID iff behavior, allowed-surface, and compatibility all pass; otherwise INVALID. Oracle infrastructure failure is METHODOLOGY_FAILURE.

T1.anti_overfit: evaluator constructs unseen legacy, valid, and malformed instances independent of candidate tests
T1.prohibited_gate: any diff path outside allowed_surface => INVALID

T2.anti_overfit: oracle mutates a private temporary candidate worktree with values absent from visible context
T2.compatibility: repository validator passes after fixture restoration
observable_behavior: evaluator-created exact duplicate rejected with duplicate diagnostic
T2.prohibited_gate: any diff path outside allowed_surface => INVALID
